rawFindings.title: Relative Karma URLs are no longer formatted or source-mapped
rawFindings.explanation: The new regular expression only matches URLs that start with `http://.../`. Stack traces that contain relative Karma URLs such as `/base/b.js:2:6` no longer match, so `formatError` leaves them unchanged instead of resolving `/base` against `basePath` and applying the served file's source map.
rawFindings.suggestion: Allow the host portion to be optional again, e.g. use a prefix like `(?:http:\/\/[^\/]*)?\/?` before `(base|absolute)`, or add an alternate branch for relative `/base` and `/absolute` URLs.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `basePath` set to `/some/base`, served file `/some/base/b.js` having a source map, and message `at /base/b.js:2:6`, the formatter now returns `at /base/b.js:2:6\n` instead of `at /some/base/b.js:2:6 <- /original/b.js:4:8\n`.
